title: Correct final expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the altitude h in the form h = (gR²/ω²)^(1/3) - R or an algebraically equivalent expression.

title: Applies Newton's Gravitation Law
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly state the gravitational force on the satellite as GMm/(R+h)².

title: Equates to centripetal force
description: Important Criteria: The solution must set the gravitational force equal to the required centripetal force m(R+h)ω² for circular orbit.

title: Uses surface gravity relation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must eliminate the product GM by using the relation g = GM/R² from conditions at Earth's surface.

title: Correct algebraic manipulation
description: Important Criteria: The steps to solve for h from the combined equation (gR²)/(R+h)² = (R+h)ω² must be logically sound.

title: Identifies geostationary condition
description: Optional Criteria: The response may explicitly note that the satellite's orbital period matches Earth's rotational period, so angular velocity is ω.

title: Sign or conceptual error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the centripetal force formula is incorrectly written (e.g., using R instead of R+h) or if gravitational and centrifugal forces are misidentified.

title: Algebraic or unit mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points for significant algebraic errors in solving for h or for incorrectly handling the cube root.
